profile.headline: Lead Front End Engineer at Booz Allen
profile.summary: Experienced Front End Developer with a BS in Computer Science from Hood College. Skilled in JavaScript, Ember.js, AngularJS, npm, Node, HTML/CSS, Bootstrap, SASS/LESS, Apache Cordova, and Java.

positions.title: Lead Frontend Developer (NSF contract)
positions.description:
Set architectural goals for the program's frontend teams to improve code quality, security, and communication between teams

Primarily used Bootstrap and SASS for styling single page apps written in EmberJS

Re-wrote sections of code to make use of Ember Data and Ember models instead of using regular Ajax calls

Updated Ajax calls with Fetch, replaced JQuery usage with Native Javascript leading to notable improvements in maintainability and cross browser accessibility

Refactored classic Ember components with Glimmer components and native Javascript classes

Developed new features using EmberJS, vanilla JS, Typescript, various Ember add-ons, and SASS

Mentored junior and senior developers on EmberJS and our various applications

Helped track down defects and assisted backend developers with testing for and resolving issues with Java Spring APIs

Made recommendations for frontend development to project manager, product owner, enterprise UX team, and program wide initiatives

Assisted other teams using EmberJS to develop generic addons, test them in multiple applications, and publish them to internal Nexus repo for use with npm

Worked with DevOps to test Jenkins jobs for frontend EmberJS projects

Used Selenium and Serenity to develop end-to-end automated testing to match acceptance criteria and improve test coverage

Ran SortSite, aXe, Wave, and SiteImprove tools to check for 508 issues, analyzed high and critical accessibility issues, implemented, and suggested fixes

Managed Bitbucket Git branches, release, and merging strategy for EmberJS projects

Used AWS tools like CloudWatch to monitor logs and check the health of our frontend and backend deployments

Analyzed, demoed, and compiled cost basis analysis for various MacOS testing solutions and eventually assisted with implementing, testing, and managing MacOS EC2

Leveraged AI tools like Amazon Q to help speed up turnaround time on boilerplate work and framework upgrades
positions.insights: Skills: Ember.js · Jenkins · HTML · Handlebars.js · Scrum · Agile Methodologies · Bitbucket · Jira · Confluence · QUnit · SASS · Node.js · TypeScript · CSS · npm · JSON · Git · Selenium · Serenity · AJAX · Okta Single Sign-On · OAuth

positions.title: Sr/Lead Front End Developer (NSF contract)
positions.description:
Quickly picked up on EmberJS and became a productive member of the team within the first month

Investigated and resolved OAuth issues related to authentication handshake with the client side

Set architectural goals for the program's frontend teams to improve code quality, security, and communication between teams

Primarily used Bootstrap and SASS for styling single page apps written in EmberJS

Re-wrote sections of code to make use of Ember Data and Ember models instead of using regular Ajax calls

Developed new features using EmberJS, vanilla JS, Typescript, various Ember add-ons, and SASS

Drastically reduced a backlog of defects by over 100 issues within two weeks

Mentored junior and senior developers on EmberJS and our various applications

Helped track down defects and assisted backend developers with testing for/resolving issues with Java Spring APIs

Made recommendations for frontend development to project manager, product owner, enterprise UX team, and program wide initiatives

Assisted other teams using EmberJS to develop generic addons, test them in multiple applications, and publish them to internal Nexus repo for use with npm

Worked with DevOps to put together Jenkins jobs for new frontend EmberJS projects

Used Selenium and Serenity to develop end-to-end automated testing to match acceptance criteria and improve test coverage

Ran SortSite, aXe, Wave, and SiteImprove tools to check for 508 issues, analyzed high and critical accessibility issues, and implemented/suggested fixes

Managed Bitbucket Git branches, release, and merging strategy for EmberJS projects

Assisted in the testing of new AWS cloud deployments and used tools like CloudWatch to monitor logs
positions.insights: Skills: Selenium · Java · QUnit · Project Planning · HTML · SASS · SVN · Node.js · Troubleshooting · Bootstrap · SQL · TypeScript · Microsoft Excel · Project Management · Serenity · JavaScript · jQuery · CSS · npm · Ember.js · Jenkins · Git · AJAX · JSON · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
Wrote CSS for various parts of Strayer Studios' lesson plans and activities on their Blackboard site.

Used native JavaScript to inject styles and classes when needed (and to handle styling of Strayer content within iframes)
positions.insights: Skills: Project Planning · HTML · Troubleshooting · JavaScript · jQuery · CSS

positions.title: Junior Mobile Developer
positions.description:
Tested and fixed issues with website, iOS, and Android applications using a mix of HTML/CSS, native code in both mobile environments, Cordova, and JavaScript (AngularJS and Typescript)

Refactored/removed non-working or broken code and code that needed updates due to new mobile operating system releases

Improved tech stack and maintainability by championing Typescript pre-Angular 2.0

Ideated and implemented a mobile browser "widget" version of our mobile app to improve user accessibility

Went through the application submittal process through Apple and Google Play and quickly turned around any required changes brought up during Apple's app testing
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · Java · Project Planning · HTML · Troubleshooting · Objective-C · Software as a Service (SaaS) · iOS Development · SQL · TypeScript · Apache Cordova · JavaScript · jQuery · CSS · LESS · Git · AJAX · Android Development · JSON · Mobile Application Development · PhoneGap · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Web Developer (Consultant)
positions.description:
Developed web pages with HTML, CSS3, PHP, and JavaScript (JQuery)

Took PSD graphics, sliced them, and turned them into web pages
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Troubleshooting · JavaScript · jQuery · CSS

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Quickly learned and efficiently used Enforme's content management system to develop informed consent documents

Managed and formatted informed consent content on web pages using HTML

Styled web pages with a responsive design by using LESS/CSS in order to fix issues with upgrading Bootstrap 2.0 to Bootstrap 3.0
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Troubleshooting · JavaScript · jQuery · CSS

positions.title: Jr. Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed web services using XHTML, XML, CSS, jQuery, and SQL through JTAP (Java EE application)

Handled the data modeling using PowerDesigner and ran scripts in SQL Developer/Toad for new release packages

System tested web services in accordance with functional designs

Learned how to program user objects and screens using PowerBuilder

Discovered, fixed, and tracked issues before and after production phase of releases using XML, CSS, JavaScript (jQuery), Powerbuilder, SQL, PL/SQL (Procedures, Functions, and Triggers)
positions.insights: Skills: Java · HTML · PowerBuilder · Troubleshooting · XML · SQL · Microsoft Excel · JavaScript · jQuery · CSS · PowerDesigner · PL/SQL

positions.title: Change/Problem Management Intern
positions.description:
Developed and managed a spreadsheet with extensive VBA macros designed to quickly track progress and fill in data for new and current video conferencing projects (successfully managed two of these projects)

Ran SQL queries in Remedy to compile and organize request for change data for monthly status updates

Updated standard operating procedures using knowledge of ITIL and Problem/Incident Management
positions.insights: Skills: Networking · Troubleshooting · SQL · Microsoft Excel · Visual Basic for Applications (VBA)

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Assisted IT department with network issues
Maintained Xerox workcentre printer
Contacted client base for technical assistance with media content and player and screen troubleshooting
Learned much about practical business operations and terminology
Generated spreadsheets and flow charts for organizing company procedures and processes
Edited emails and revised company updates

positions.title: E-Portfolio Technician
positions.description:
Led instructional sessions for the Chalk and Wire E-Portfolio system
Created Excel spreadsheets for Help Desk work hours, Department minutes, Chalk and Wire submissions, and Chalk and Wire account purchases
Troubleshooted the Chalk and Wire E-Portfolio system for Education students in the undergraduate and graduate programs
Developed a sample customized portfolio using html and various Chalk and Wire applications 
Assisted in renewing Hood College’s Certification for Educational Teaching by organizing and cataloguing past student data and sample portfolios
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Troubleshooting · Microsoft Excel · JavaScript · jQuery · CSS
